provenance: Written by the assistant (Claude) in the developer's session, not by faculty. The 16 items with `origin` set are copies of the ILO-CLO, CLO-EGA and CLO-PO items of dataset.json (eval-1.1), unchanged. The program outcomes below are generic test wording for fictional programs, NOT the school's official POs. The EGAs are the school's four official graduate-attribute NAMES (the system holds no longer description for them).

splits.dev: Used to compare and improve prompt wording. Every item may be inspected.
splits.heldout: Written before any prompt variant was run and never used to tune a prompt. Reported only as aggregates by default (scripts/eval-alignment.cjs --dataset alignment --split heldout); every held-out run is appended to docs/ai-eval-heldout-log.jsonl so the number of looks is visible. Do not tune on it.
splits.faculty: Items a faculty reviewer has confirmed (reviewStatus 'faculty-reviewed'). None yet.
